description: painterly pixel art in the style of Eastward, 3/4 top-down view with fronts drawn straight-on (not isometric), sunlight from the upper left, full value range from deep cool shadows to bright warm highlights, hue-shifted colour ramps, adaptive dark coloured outlines (never pure black), chunky readable silhouette, no text + a flat stone-rim border piece centred on a transparent background — only the fitted stones and moss, no water, no grass fill + mossy fitted shore stones, wet dark stone on the water side, dry sandy stone on the land side, small moss and lichen patches + cool highland pine forest palette
